intent.purpose: slideshow frame: casual post-workout stretch photo taken by a friend
intent.scene_concept: woman sitting on a mat on a commercial gym floor doing a quad stretch, photographed by a friend standing in front of her
intent.place_type: commercial gym with large windows (not a home gym, not a yoga studio)
must_stay_true: it is a working commercial gym with dumbbell racks and a cable machine
she is seated on a mat mid-stretch, holding one foot
daylight from big windows mixed with ceiling LEDs

appeal.relative_to_inspiration: as attractive as or more attractive than the source posts this scene class came from; the rawness is in the photo, not in her looks
appeal.face: pretty, well-defined features, flushed and glowing from training
appeal.physique: fit athletic hourglass: toned legs, tight waist, slim soft arms

subject.description: one woman cooling down after training
subject.action: holding her left shoe behind her in a seated quad stretch while her right hand rests on the mat
subject.pose: seated on the mat, right leg folded in front, left knee bent with the foot pulled back by the left hand, torso upright with a slight lean
subject.expression: calm, slightly out of breath, closed-mouth half-smile

identity.skin: light warm skin, flushed cheeks, light sweat on the forehead and upper chest
identity.hair: chin-to-shoulder length blonde hair, tucked behind one ear, damp at the hairline
identity.face: minimal makeup, natural brows, pretty well-defined features with natural asymmetry

physique.proportions: realistic adult proportions, natural waist, strong legs
physique.detail: toned stomach with a natural soft fold when seated, no exaggerated muscle definition

items: pale pink short-sleeve fitted training top
white and pale-pink chunky running shoes
beige over-ear wireless headphones worn on the head
wardrobe.fit_and_condition: top creased at the waist, sweat darkening the collar slightly, shoes lightly scuffed

foreground: light wood stretching platform edge at the bottom of the frame
a half-empty water bottle and a small towel on the platform
background: black rubber floor with visible tile seams and chalk marks
long black dumbbell rack at the left
black cable machine at the right
exposed dark ceiling with ducts and linear LED fixtures
one other member training far in the background
environment.clutter: normal gym clutter: a stray plate against the rack, a bench slightly out of line

camera.position: standing about two metres in front, phone at chest height pointing slightly down
camera.depth_of_field: deep; the whole gym is readable

composition.framing: full body with the platform, a lot of gym around her
composition.subject_placement: slightly below centre and a little right
composition.crop: one shoe near the bottom edge
composition.tilt: about 2 degrees; the window mullions lean slightly

sources: daylight through large windows at left and behind
lighting.direction: mostly from the left and behind
lighting.quality: bright, diffused, with soft contact shadows under her legs
lighting.exposure: windows slightly overexposed, subject a little dim on the camera side

color.white_balance: neutral, slightly cool from the LEDs
color.saturation: saturated pinks against a neutral gym
casts: cool LED cast on the black floor
faint pink bounce on the platform

processing.hdr: Smart HDR keeping the windows from clipping completely

imperfections: a stray plate and an unaligned bench in the background
chalk dust and scuffs on the floor

texture.skin: real skin with slight sweat sheen, knees a little red from the mat
texture.hair: damp strands at the hairline, flyaways
texture.fabric: technical fabric with seam lines and stretch creases, ribbed socks
texture.surfaces: rubber floor texture, wood grain on the platform, matte black steel

motion.subject: holding the stretch, still
motion.blur: none on the subject; the background member slightly motion-blurred

anatomy: two arms, two legs, correct knee and ankle bends
the left hand actually grips the left shoe behind her
five fingers on each visible hand
physics: her weight sits on the mat with contact shadows
dumbbells sit in their rack slots in size order
cable machine cables run straight to their pulleys
geometry.reflections: window glass shows faint reflections of the ceiling lights only
geometry.perspective: natural 1x phone perspective; window verticals nearly straight

phone.hold: the friend's phone is the camera and is not visible

typography.scene_text: small equipment decals too far away to read

brands_and_props.branding_policy: keep natural branding: real-looking manufacturer decals on the machines and a small logo on the shoes and headphones are fine; do not invent readable text
brands: small manufacturer decal on the cable machine
small logo on the running shoes

exclusions: no Apple Watch or any smartwatch
no fitness-model pose or exaggerated muscles
no studio lighting or dramatic spotlight
no teal-orange grade or cinematic look
